item.text:
Completed the fee migration and subscription version changes.

Existing subscriptions can still read their legacy monthly fee. New versions omit the previous fee so it can be decided again. The migration backfills the price effective on the approval date and rolls back with a count and subscription IDs if any backfilled fee is negative.

`bun test` passed. PostgreSQL 18 checks also verified a subscription created before migration, a later price change, and rollback with SQLSTATE `P0001` for a negative fee.
